Public Works Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Tamil Nadu · IN
 
 No. CC/1/2014/090 
 Dated: 31 Mar 2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Canal Lining - Tamil Nadu Pkg-90" (irrigation), awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd.
 (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on 20 Jun 2014 at a gross executed value of Rs.
 2609.00 Lakh (Rupees 26.09 Crore Only). 
 The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and contract conditions. The quality of work
 has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the undersigned.
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Manoj Verma. This certificate is issued for record and for submission with future
 tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Public Works Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CC-090 Page 1 of 1
